summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on addressing an issue with the 15-64 age demographic data for Mexico. Since CityData is expected to fix the age breakdown within two weeks, [p1] proposed a temporary workaround: implementing a custom distribution for the 15-64 age group using current internet data, which appeared generally adequate. This approach would prevent displaying an incomplete or problematic column until CityData updates its official figures.

Separately, there was a discussion regarding the JCD Brasilia airport data, with [p1] confirming they could assist in formatting it into the required format.
decisions: Implement a custom distribution for the 15-64 age demographic data as a temporary workaround until CityData updates its figures.
action_items: [me] to raise the priority of the JCD Brasilia airport task.
[p1] to assist with formatting the JCD Brasilia airport data into the required format.
